title: Back after many years
content: I have been struggling to remember my dreams for many years so to have one this vivid was remarkable. In this dream I was in what appeared to be what I can only describe as a modern 80's style campus/dorm with wide hallways and rows of rooms lining each side. In my dream I was visiting people in their rooms and looking for my long lost items that I had stashed there in the past. I felt certain I had been in this dream world before and had stored these things a long time ago. The items were perfumes and hair and makeup products. I was trying to get ready for an event and needed these to prepare but because I had to hunt down all my old hiding spots, I felt an increasing sense of urgency because I would be late. My hair was a mess because I couldn't style it properly until I found my products. I was going from room to room asking people to help me find my lost items. I would stop at certain doors that I somehow knew my items were in. Some of the missing things were recovered, tucked into the back of a medicine cabinet, night-side table or bathroom closet, some were not. This dream made me feel so panicked that it woke me up right before the alarm. I had a terrible day at work that same day and assumed the stress had brought this on. Anyone have a similar experience? &#x200B;
